versions.changelog:
MarketUP管理 v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides comprehensive Marketup CRM workflows: detail/list search, advanced filtering, creation, modification, assignment, lead history/behavior lookup, lead-to-account conversion, tags, and pool configuration.
- Strictly enforces API Key validation and setup before any Marketup API operations.
- All write operations report results only after actual API responses, ensuring data accuracy.
- Supports structured entity field definition lookup and correct field mapping for all create/modify actions.
